title: Resume must heal an ADR-0105 B1 carrier left at HEAD between the rebase and the pend (required before B3/B4)
problem: ADR-0105 B1 replaces ship's commit with a carrier commit of the audited tree, rebases it, then soft-resets it to pending. A crash after the carrier reset but before the rebase heals itself: a re-ship binds the audited tree and the unwind repeats. A crash after the rebase but before the pend leaves the carrier rebased onto the new base as a commit. The resumed ship then fails its tree binding (T1 is not T0) and goes to a re-audit of a committed change, whose `git diff HEAD` is empty: the hazard B1's route guard exists to prevent. The B1 architect review requires this heal before B3 or B4 builds on B1.
fix: On resume, before any phase runs, recognise a commit at HEAD whose message carries an `Evolve-Carrier: cycle-<N>/<run>` trailer naming this cycle and run, and pend it: `git reset --soft $(git merge-base HEAD main)`. Record a coded signal. The trailer is written by unwindShipCommit.
acceptance: A resume with a rebased carrier at HEAD leaves the change pending on its fork point before Ship or Audit runs.
A carrier naming another cycle or run is left alone.
The design review's crash-window table gains both B1 windows with their recovery.
